question: Where does each check run's workflow file come from, and in what form? Can it be read as the `path` of the check run's check suite's workflow run, with the permissions the reader and the Controller hold, in the one read of the facts, and does that `path` ever carry a ref suffix or take a `dynamic/` form, which the port passes on verbatim, never as null? Does the check run `CodeQL` that GitHub Advanced Security reports have a workflow run at all? Where does a check run created through the API with `GITHUB_TOKEN` and `checks: write` land, in which check suite and under which workflow path, and can that token update a check run of another workflow's run? And does a job a pull request adds in a file of its own, under a required Lens's check name, report under GitHub Actions with that file's path?
pass: Each answered and recorded; the path readable within the budget P-8 measures; CodeQL's check with no workflow run; a check created with `GITHUB_TOKEN` under its own workflow's path and unable to change another's. Written before the run, in the design's row. The check runs of seven heads: a pull request's, where CodeQL's suite is first; a push's with two workflows and no CodeQL; a push whose job tries to forge a job's details; a push where a job posts a success under the names of another workflow's failing jobs, before one fails and after the other; a push with a job gated on another, a job trying to change another's check, and a post to another branch's head; a push trying each field of another job's check alone; and a push whose job tries to give its own created check a job's details. The Controller's half stands on the reader's read, by the orchestrator's ruling of 2026-10-31: the reader read the path in P-8, and each permission it holds the Controller holds too (config/apps.json); no token of the Controller's asked it. A fork's token is read-only by GitHub's documents, not tried here.

file: # Platform trial P-35 (combsmith/software-factory#186): can a job PATCH its own created check run's details_url to a real
# job's form, with the id of the run whose suite it landed in, and that check's own id? Created in progress and created
# completed, and read back after each.
- name: Create, then PATCH its own details
for state in in_progress completed; do
if [ "$state" = completed ]; then extra="-f conclusion=success"; else extra=""; fi
id=$(gh api -X POST "repos/$REPO/check-runs" -f name="p35-self-$state" -f head_sha="$GITHUB_SHA" -f status=$state $extra --jq .id)
echo "P35 self $state: id=$id suite=$suite run=$run own_run=$GITHUB_RUN_ID"
code=$(gh api -i -X PATCH "repos/$REPO/check-runs/$id" -f details_url="$url" 2>&1 | sed -n 1p | cut -c1-40)
gh api "repos/$REPO/check-runs/$id" --jq '"P35 self '"$state"' then: details=\(.details_url) status=\(.status)"'
code=$(gh api -i -X POST "repos/$REPO/check-runs" -f name="p35-self-posted-$state" -f head_sha="$GITHUB_SHA" -f status=$state $extra -f details_url="$url" 2>&1 | sed -n 1p | cut -c1-40)
echo "P35 self posted with a job's details: $code"
gh api "repos/$REPO/commits/$GITHUB_SHA/check-runs?filter=all&per_page=100" --jq '.check_runs[]|"P35 listed: id=\(.id) name=\(.name) details=\(.details_url)"'
gh api -X PATCH "repos/$REPO/check-runs/$c" -f status=completed -f conclusion=success --jq '"P35 own finished: status=\(.status) conclusion=\(.conclusion) details=\(.details_url)"'
